Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for assay CHEMBL3885863. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures, then to activities, then to assays. Filter by assay CHEMBL3865863 and exact measurements (standard_value IS NOT NULL and standard_relation '='). Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
